med-econ-01-c3.text: Local News Initiative, Medill School of Journalism, Northwestern University (2024). The State of Local News 2024 report. Northwestern University Medill Local News Initiative.
med-econ-01-c3.quote: there are 206 counties across the country without any news source, up from 204 last year
med-econ-01-c3.claim: The 'news desert' phenomenon, counties with no local news organisation at all, affected over 200 US counties by the mid-2020s.
